sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但查明身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: On the evening of Friday, October 12, 2001, the married father of two finished work for the day and headed to his local drinking spot, the BSV Neuborg.
sentences.zh: 2001年10月12日，星期五晚上，这位已婚并育有两个孩子的父亲结束了一天的工作，前往他常去的饮酒场所——BSV纽堡俱乐部。

sentences.en: By day, the BSV was a popular sporting ground for residents of Neuborg-under-Dunau, a small Bavarian town in southeast Germany.
sentences.zh: 白天，BSV是德国东南部巴伐利亚小镇纽堡-翁特-多瑙（Neuborg-under-Dunau）居民们热门的运动场所。

sentences.en: Boasting two soccer fields, seven tennis courts, and a gymnasium, it provided a welcoming space for locals of all ages to participate in group fitness activities.
sentences.zh: 这里拥有两个足球场、七个网球场和一个体育馆，为当地各年龄段的居民提供了参与集体健身活动的舒适空间。

sentences.en: By night, the clubhouse offered a casual pub-like atmosphere for members of the community to socialise over drinks and dinner.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上，俱乐部会所则为社区成员提供了一个休闲的酒吧氛围，供大家聚会饮酒和用餐。

sentences.en: Rudolf Roep was a regular at the clubhouse, as it was only a few minutes' drive from the
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫·鲁普（Rudolf Roep）是俱乐部的常客，因为这里距离

sentences.en: Roep family's farm.
sentences.zh: 鲁普一家的农场只有几分钟的车程。

sentences.en: After parking his beloved Mercedes outside, Rudolf took a seat at his regular table, which was off to the side, away from other guests.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫把心爱的奔驰车停在外面后，就在他常坐的桌子旁坐下，那张桌子位于侧面，远离其他客人。

sentences.en: As usual, he had come straight to the clubhouse from the barn without stopping to change his soiled overalls and gumboots.
sentences.zh: 像往常一样，他从谷仓直接来到俱乐部，甚至没停下来换掉身上沾满污垢的工作服和胶靴。

sentences.en: The stench ensured other patrons kept their distance.
sentences.zh: 那股恶臭让其他顾客对他敬而远之。

sentences.en: But it wasn't the only reason they avoided Rudolf Roep.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是他们避开鲁道夫·鲁普的唯一原因。

sentences.en: After a few beers, he was known to become argumentative and obnoxious, and he had a reputation around town for being a brawler.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，他喝了几杯啤酒后就会变得爱争辩且令人讨厌，他在镇上还有个好斗的名声。

sentences.en: Over the next few hours, Rudolf sat drinking wheat beers and smoking cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几个小时里，鲁道夫坐在那里喝着小麦啤酒，抽着烟。

sentences.en: The clubhouse slowly cleared out, and by 1am, he was one of three patrons left.
sentences.zh: 俱乐部的人渐渐散去，到凌晨1点时，他成了仅剩的三名顾客之一。

sentences.en: The pub's owner, Werner Steger, was ready to close for the night.
sentences.zh: 酒吧老板维尔纳·斯泰格（Werner Steger）准备打烊了。

sentences.en: He offered to give Rudolf a lift home, but Rudolf declined, saying he had his Mercedes out the front.
sentences.zh: 他提出开车送鲁道夫回家，但鲁道夫拒绝了，说他的奔驰车就停在前面。

sentences.en: Anyone who knew Rudolf knew that his E230 model Mercedes was his pride and joy.
sentences.zh: 认识鲁道夫的人都知道，他的E230型奔驰车是他的心头好。

sentences.en: Werner walked his three lingering customers outside.
sentences.zh: 维尔纳把最后的三位顾客送出了门。

sentences.en: Rudolf got into his car and reversed out, narrowly avoiding hitting a flower pot on the way.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫上了车倒车离开，途中差点撞到一个花盆。

sentences.en: At the car park exit, he made a right turn towards his home, the headlights of his Mercedes slowly fading into the darkness.
sentences.zh: 在停车场出口，他右转驶向家的方向，奔驰车的车灯渐渐消失在黑暗中。

sentences.en: Later that same day, Saturday October 13, 49-year-old Hermina Roep approached one of her neighbours in tears.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，即10月13日星期六，49岁的赫米娜·鲁普（Hermina Roep）含泪找到了一位邻居。

sentences.en: Hermina explained that her husband hadn't come home the night before and she didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜解释说，她丈夫昨晚没回家，她不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: She asked her neighbour if they had a phone book she could borrow.
sentences.zh: 她问邻居有没有电话簿可以借用。

sentences.en: She wanted to call the BSV Neuborg to see if anyone there could shed any light on Rudolf's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 她想给BSV纽堡俱乐部打电话，看看有没有人能提供鲁道夫下落的线索。

sentences.en: Hermina contacted the club and spoke to the owner, Werner Steger.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜联系了俱乐部，并与老板维尔纳·斯泰格通了话。

sentences.en: Werner was taken aback to discover that Rudolf hadn't made it home.
sentences.zh: 得知鲁道夫没能回家，维尔纳感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: He recalled that Rudolf had been a little unsteady on his feet when he left the previous evening, but had otherwise seemed fine.
sentences.zh: 他回忆说，鲁道夫前一天晚上离开时脚步有些不稳，但除此之外看起来并无异常。

sentences.en: There had been no incidents at the clubhouse to suggest Rudolf could have found himself in any trouble.
sentences.zh: 俱乐部里并没有发生任何迹象表明鲁道夫可能遇到了麻烦。

sentences.en: As hours passed with no signs of Rudolf, Hermina eventually contacted the police to report her husband missing.
sentences.zh: 随着时间流逝，鲁道夫仍不见踪影，赫米娜最终联系了警方，报告丈夫失踪。

sentences.en: A check of Rudolf's tab at the BSV revealed that he'd drunk eight beers throughout the course of the evening.
sentences.zh: 对鲁道夫在BSV的消费记录进行核查后发现，他当晚一共喝了八杯啤酒。

sentences.en: This suggested a blood alcohol reading well over the legal limit.
sentences.zh: 这表明他的血液酒精浓度远超法定限值。

sentences.en: The obvious possibility was that Rudolf could have gotten into a car accident.
sentences.zh: 最明显的可能性是鲁道夫可能遭遇了车祸。

sentences.en: The Roop family lived less than two kilometres from the BSV.
sentences.zh: 鲁普一家住在距离BSV不到两公里的地方。

sentences.en: A search of the roads in the area revealed no sign of Rudolf, his prized Mercedes, or any evidence of a car accident.
sentences.zh: 对该地区道路的搜寻没有发现鲁道夫、他那辆珍贵的奔驰车或任何车祸的痕迹。

sentences.en: This wasn't the first time police had been called to the Roop residence.
sentences.zh: 这已经不是警方第一次接到关于鲁普家的报警了。

sentences.en: Rudolf and Hermina lived on the farm with their two daughters, 15-year-old Andrea and 16-year-old
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫和赫米娜与他们的两个女儿住在农场里，分别是15岁的安德烈亚（Andrea）和16岁的

sentences.en: Manuela.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉（Manuela）。

sentences.en: Both teens had mild intellectual disabilities and were required to attend a special needs high school.
sentences.zh: 两个孩子都有轻度智力障碍，需要就读特殊教育高中。

sentences.en: However, they rarely attended, which prompted visits from the authorities to check on their welfare.
sentences.zh: 然而，她们很少去上学，这促使有关部门多次上门核查她们的生活状况。

sentences.en: In the past, police had also been notified of noise complaints stemming from the property.
sentences.zh: 过去，警方还曾接到过关于该房产的噪音投诉。

sentences.en: The Roop family farm left a lot to be desired.
sentences.zh: 鲁普一家的农场状况堪忧。

sentences.en: Rudolf inherited the property from his parents, but after his mother's death in 1996,
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫从父母那里继承了这处房产，但在1996年他母亲去世后，

sentences.en: 2007, he struggled to maintain it.
sentences.zh: 到了2007年，他已难以维持农场的运营。

sentences.en: Everything had become run down and the agricultural endeavours barely turned a profit.
sentences.zh: 一切都变得破败不堪，农业经营几乎没有利润。

sentences.en: To make ends meet, the Roops rented the upper level of their farmhouse to a tenant.
sentences.zh: 为了维持生计，鲁普一家将农舍的楼上租给了一名租客。

sentences.en: When questioned, the tenant described conditions in the Roop home as antisocial.
sentences.zh: 当被问及时，租客形容鲁普家里的氛围非常反社会。

sentences.en: They said that the family argued often and Rudolf was constantly drunk.
sentences.zh: 他们说家里经常争吵，鲁道夫总是喝得烂醉。

sentences.en: The tenant mostly went out of his way to avoid Rudolf.
sentences.zh: 租客大多会刻意避开鲁道夫。

sentences.en: It was a sentiment shared by other associates of the family, who described Rudolf as a bossy and domineering alcoholic.
sentences.zh: 与该家庭有往来的其他人也有同感，他们将鲁道夫描述为一个专横跋扈的酒鬼。

sentences.en: Some considered him a tyrant who seemed to enjoy humiliating his family.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为他是个暴君，似乎以羞辱家人为乐。

sentences.en: One relative said they were ashamed to be associated with the Roops.
sentences.zh: 一位亲戚说，他们为与鲁普一家有关系感到羞耻。

sentences.en: Yet, another described Rudolf as a helpful and generous father.
sentences.zh: 然而，另一个人却将鲁道夫描述为一个乐于助人且慷慨的父亲。

sentences.en: He tried his best to give his daughters whatever they wanted, including two pet horses and video games.
sentences.zh: 他尽其所能满足女儿们想要的一切，包括两匹宠物马和电子游戏。

sentences.en: There wasn't anything at the Roop home to indicate that Rudolf had packed up and left on his own accord.
sentences.zh: 鲁普家中没有任何迹象表明鲁道夫是自愿收拾行李离开的。

sentences.en: His farm work was left incomplete and he hadn't tried to tie up any loose ends.
sentences.zh: 他的农活没干完，也没有试图处理任何未竟之事。

sentences.en: It didn't seem likely that he'd choose to up and leave without a word.
sentences.zh: 他似乎不太可能不辞而别。

sentences.en: A check of Rudolf's finances revealed that the Roop family were living well beyond their means.
sentences.zh: 对鲁道夫财务状况的调查显示，鲁普一家的生活水平远超他们的经济能力。

sentences.en: Rudolf had once owned several properties, but with the farm failing to return a profit, each of these properties had since been sold.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫曾经拥有多处房产，但由于农场无法盈利，这些房产后来都被卖掉了。

sentences.en: In 1999, the Roops farmhouse had been placed into foreclosure and visits from a bailiff were commonplace.
sentences.zh: 1999年，鲁普家的农舍被抵押赎回，法警上门催债成了家常便饭。

sentences.en: To support his family, Rudolf had reluctantly resorted to selling off his farmland.
sentences.zh: 为了养家糊口，鲁道夫不得不勉强卖掉自己的农田。

sentences.en: In the lead up to his disappearance, he'd sold a plot of land for around 1 million Deutschmarks, the equivalent to around 857,000 Australian dollars at the time.
sentences.zh: 在他失踪前夕，他以约100万德国马克的价格卖掉了一块土地，相当于当时约85.7万澳元。

sentences.en: It was unclear what the money from the property sale had been spent on, but it didn't appear to have helped the Roops' financial situation.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚卖地所得的钱花在了哪里，但这似乎并没有改善鲁普一家的经济状况。

sentences.en: At the time of Rudolf's disappearance, he owed roughly 882,000 Deutschmarks, which included 80,000 Deutschmarks in income tax.
sentences.zh: 在鲁道夫失踪时，他欠债约88.2万德国马克，其中包括8万德国马克的所得税。

sentences.en: Less than two weeks prior to his disappearance,
sentences.zh: 在他失踪前不到两周，

sentences.en: Rudolf had been summoned with an affidavit regarding unpaid debts.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫因未偿债务收到了传票。

sentences.en: With the farm and rental property only bringing in a meagre income, the only option Rudolf had left was to sell more of his land.
sentences.zh: 由于农场和出租房产的收入微薄，鲁道夫剩下的唯一选择就是卖掉更多的土地。

sentences.en: Then there was the issue of Rudolf's health.
sentences.zh: 此外还有鲁道夫的健康问题。

sentences.en: Rudolf had type 2 diabetes, the symptoms of which were exacerbated by his unhealthy lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫患有2型糖尿病，不健康的生活方式加剧了他的症状。

sentences.en: If he didn't make some changes, doctors had warned Rudolf that one of his legs would have to be amputated.
sentences.zh: 医生曾警告鲁道夫，如果他不做出改变，他的一条腿将不得不被截肢。

sentences.en: Considerations led to the belief that Rudolf might have taken his own life.
sentences.zh: 这些考量让人认为鲁道夫可能已经自杀。

sentences.en: Those who knew him denied this possibility.
sentences.zh: 但认识他的人否认了这种可能性。

sentences.en: While Rudolf was in a rough place financially, he felt he had things under control.
sentences.zh: 虽然鲁道夫在经济上处境艰难，但他觉得一切尽在掌握。

sentences.en: His diabetes didn't seem to bother him too much either.
sentences.zh: 他的糖尿病似乎也没有对他造成太大困扰。

sentences.en: He'd never shown any signs of depression or voiced a desire to end things.
sentences.zh: 他从未表现出任何抑郁迹象，也没有流露过轻生的念头。

sentences.en: Other guests who interacted with Rudolf at the BSV Neuborg on the night before he disappeared said he'd seemed like his usual self.
sentences.zh: 在失踪前一晚与鲁道夫在BSV纽堡俱乐部有过接触的其他客人表示，他看起来和往常一样。

sentences.en: There was no evidence, such as a suicide note or the wrapping up of affairs, to support the suicide theory either.
sentences.zh: 也没有证据（如遗书或处理后事）支持自杀理论。

sentences.en: Regardless, investigators weren't prepared to rule out that Rudolf had been keeping some dark thoughts to himself and made a rash decision in his drunken state.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，调查人员并未排除鲁道夫可能将一些阴暗的想法藏在心里，并在醉酒状态下做出了草率决定。

sentences.en: There was just one problem.
sentences.zh: 但有一个问题。

sentences.en: If Rudolf had gone away somewhere to kill himself, it didn't make sense that his Mercedes had vanished with him.
sentences.zh: 如果鲁道夫去别处自杀了，那么他的奔驰车随他一起消失就说不通了。

sentences.en: The Rupps farm was situated within close proximity to the Dunau River, the second largest river in Europe.
sentences.zh: 鲁普农场靠近欧洲第二大河流——多瑙河。

sentences.en: It could be reached by car from the BSV Neuborg in less than 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 从BSV纽堡俱乐部开车不到15分钟就能到达河边。

sentences.en: Other bodies of water, such as Tseller Lake and Iger-Tamer Pond, were also less than 10km from the BSV.
sentences.zh: 其他水域，如策勒湖（Tseller Lake）和伊格-塔默池塘（Iger-Tamer Pond），距离BSV也不到10公里。

sentences.en: A cursory search of the waterways didn't indicate any cars had driven over the banks.
sentences.zh: 对这些水域的初步搜寻没有发现任何车辆冲入河岸的迹象。

sentences.en: Police divers took to the waters, but no sign of Rudolf Rupp emerged.
sentences.zh: 警方潜水员下水搜寻，但没有发现鲁道夫·鲁普的踪迹。

sentences.en: As the months passed, search efforts intensified.
sentences.zh: 随着几个月过去，搜寻力度不断加大。

sentences.en: Authorities were advised to be on the lookout for Rudolf's Mercedes with the licence plate ND-AE-265.
sentences.zh: 当局被告知要留意车牌号为ND-AE-265的鲁道夫的奔驰车。

sentences.en: Neuborg under Dunau was surrounded by lowland forests.
sentences.zh: 纽堡-翁特-多瑙周围环绕着低地森林。

sentences.en: Police helicopters repeatedly scanned the woods, to no result.
sentences.zh: 警用直升机反复扫描树林，但一无所获。

sentences.en: No confirmed sightings of Rudolf came through, nor did he touch his bank account, making it less likely that the farmer had up and left.
sentences.zh: 没有关于鲁道夫的可靠目击报告，他也没有动用过银行账户，这使得这位农民不辞而别的可能性降低了。

sentences.en: But there was also no crime scene and no evidence of foul play.
sentences.zh: 但现场也没有犯罪痕迹，也没有证据表明存在谋杀。

sentences.en: Rudolf Rupp had disappeared into thin air.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫·鲁普就这样凭空消失了。

sentences.en: Intermittent searches of the Dunau River continued.
sentences.zh: 对多瑙河的间歇性搜寻仍在继续。

sentences.en: By 2003, police had spent 23 days examining the waterways surrounding Neuborg.
sentences.zh: 到2003年，警方已经花了23天时间检查纽堡周边的水域。

sentences.en: No sign of the missing farmer or his car emerged.
sentences.zh: 失踪农民及其车辆的踪迹依然全无。

sentences.en: In November that year, a public prosecutor was assigned to re-examine the two-year-old cold case.
sentences.zh: 那年11月，一名检察官被指派重新调查这起已尘封两年的悬案。

sentences.en: If there had been an accident or suicide, the prosecutor felt something would have surfaced by now.
sentences.zh: 检察官认为，如果发生了事故或自杀，现在应该已经有所发现了。

sentences.en: Feeling 100% certain that Rudolf Rupp wasn't in any body of water within a 5km radius of where he was last seen, the prosecutor started considering a new theory.
sentences.zh: 由于百分之百确定鲁道夫·鲁普不在他最后一次露面地点方圆5公里内的任何水域中，检察官开始考虑一种新的理论。

sentences.en: The mysterious disappearance of Rudolf Rupp had become somewhat of an urban legend for locals of Neuborg and Dunau.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫·鲁普的神秘失踪已成为纽堡和多瑙河当地的一种都市传说。

sentences.en: Just before he went missing, Rudolf's eldest daughter, 16-year-old Manuela, had become engaged to a young man named Matthias, who moved into the Rupp's farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 就在他失踪前不久，鲁道夫的大女儿，16岁的曼努埃拉，与一个名叫马蒂亚斯（Matthias）的年轻人订了婚，后者搬进了鲁普家的农舍。

sentences.en: It was common knowledge that Rudolf and Matthias didn't get along.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，鲁道夫和马蒂亚斯合不来。

sentences.en: Like Rudolf, Matthias had a proclivity for alcohol and could turn violent when under the influence.
sentences.zh: 和鲁道夫一样，马蒂亚斯也有酗酒的倾向，且在醉酒后会变得暴力。

sentences.en: According to a neighbour, Matthias had once showed up at her house drunk and threatened to kill her son.
sentences.zh: 据一位邻居说，马蒂亚斯曾醉醺醺地出现在她家，并威胁要杀了她的儿子。

sentences.en: Shortly before his disappearance, an enraged Rudolf had apparently chased Matthias off his property.
sentences.zh: 在失踪前不久，愤怒的鲁道夫显然把马蒂亚斯赶出了他的房产。

sentences.en: Gossip spread around town that Rudolf's wife, daughters and future son-in-law could have reached their breaking point.
sentences.zh: 镇上流传着一种说法：鲁道夫的妻子、女儿和未来的女婿可能已经忍无可忍了。

sentences.en: Tired of Rudolf drinking their remaining money away and running the farm into the ground, they could have hatched a plan to get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 他们厌倦了鲁道夫挥霍掉家里仅剩的钱财并搞垮农场，于是可能策划了一个除掉他的计划。

sentences.en: Although investigators had caught wind of these rumours early on, there was no evidence to suggest there was any truth to them.
sentences.zh: 尽管调查人员很早就听到了这些传言，但没有证据表明这些传言属实。

sentences.en: Upon reviewing all the evidence, the public prosecutor wasn't so sure.
sentences.zh: 在审查了所有证据后，检察官对此并不确定。

sentences.en: Without Rudolf around to work on the farm, his wife Hermina had been left with no other option but to sell more of the family's farmland.
sentences.zh: 由于没有鲁道夫在农场干活，他的妻子赫米娜别无选择，只能卖掉更多的家庭农田。

sentences.en: This was something that Rudolf had been deeply opposed to.
sentences.zh: 这是鲁道夫一直强烈反对的事情。

sentences.en: It raised some questions.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一些疑问。

sentences.en: The prosecutor considered an angle that hadn't been explored during the initial missing persons investigation.
sentences.zh: 检察官考虑了一个在最初失踪人口调查中未被探索的角度。

sentences.en: What if the family was lying when they said Rudolf never came home that night?
sentences.zh: 如果家人在说“鲁道夫那天晚上从未回家”时是在撒谎呢？

sentences.en: At 6am on Tuesday January 13, 2004, a team of investigators arrived at the Rooks farm armed with a search warrant.
sentences.zh: 2004年1月13日星期二早上6点，一组调查人员带着搜查令抵达了鲁普农场。

sentences.en: Outside, the property was in disarray.
sentences.zh: 农场外面一片混乱。

sentences.en: Rubbish, old furniture and pieces of household junk were strewn about and several large dogs roamed around.
sentences.zh: 垃圾、旧家具和各种家庭杂物散落一地，几只大狗在周围游荡。

sentences.en: The inside of the house was neglected and dirty, with a terrible stench permeating the air.
sentences.zh: 屋内肮脏不堪，疏于打理，空气中弥漫着一股恶臭。

sentences.en: Hermina, Andrea, Manuela and Matthias were all still sleeping.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜、安德烈亚、曼努埃拉和马蒂亚斯都还在睡觉。

sentences.en: Officers shook them awake and ordered them outside as a search of the house commenced.
sentences.zh: 警察将他们摇醒并命令他们到屋外，随后开始搜查房屋。

sentences.en: Investigators made their way to the basement downstairs.
sentences.zh: 调查人员前往楼下的地下室。

sentences.en: The smell was terrible.
sentences.zh: 那里的气味非常糟糕。

sentences.en: There, they found cages filled with chinchillas and ferrets.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里发现了装满龙猫和雪貂的笼子。

sentences.en: A neglected dog appeared to be on the brink of death.
sentences.zh: 一只被忽视的狗看起来奄奄一息。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the residents were taken for questioning.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，住户们被带走接受询问。

sentences.en: At this point, they were only being treated as witnesses.
sentences.zh: 此时，他们仅被视为证人对待。

sentences.en: The main aim for investigators was to establish once and for all whether Rudolf returned home in the early morning hours of October 13, 2001.
sentences.zh: 调查人员的主要目标是一劳永逸地确定鲁道夫是否在2001年10月13日凌晨回过家。

sentences.en: If they could clarify this detail, they could figure out where to go from there.
sentences.zh: 如果能澄清这个细节，他们就能确定下一步该怎么做。

sentences.en: The now 18-year-old Manuela Rook firmly denied that her father had ever come home.
sentences.zh: 现年18岁的曼努埃拉·鲁普坚决否认她父亲回过家。

sentences.en: Her mother, Hermina, also denied this, but investigators weren't convinced.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲赫米娜也否认了这一点，但调查人员并不相信。

sentences.en: They pressed Hermina and before long, she admitted that her husband had indeed come home from the BSV clubhouse that night.
sentences.zh: 他们向赫米娜施压，不久后，她承认丈夫那天晚上确实从BSV俱乐部回到了家。

sentences.en: According to Hermina, she and Rudolf were standing at the top of the basement stairs when a heated argument broke out between them.
sentences.zh: 据赫米娜说，她和鲁道夫当时站在地下室楼梯顶端，两人爆发了激烈的争吵。

sentences.en: Hermina pushed Rudolf and he fell down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜推了鲁道夫一把，他摔下了楼梯。

sentences.en: The fall was fatal.
sentences.zh: 这一摔导致他当场死亡。

sentences.en: Manuela's fiancé, Matthias, helped Hermina carry Rudolf's body outside and into Rudolf's Mercedes.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉的未婚夫马蒂亚斯帮赫米娜把鲁道夫的尸体抬到外面，放进了鲁道夫的奔驰车里。

sentences.en: Under the cover of darkness, they drove the car to the nearby Egotsheimer Pond and pushed it into the water.
sentences.zh: 在夜色的掩护下，他们开车前往附近的埃戈茨海默池塘（Egotsheimer Pond），并将车推入水中。

sentences.en: After a few days of questioning, Manuela Rook caved and corroborated the version of events provided by her mother,
sentences.zh: 经过几天的审讯，曼努埃拉·鲁普崩溃了，并证实了她母亲提供的事件版本，

sentences.en: admitting that Hermina had accidentally pushed Rudolf down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 承认赫米娜确实意外地将鲁道夫推下了楼梯。

sentences.en: Andrea Rook was now 17 years old.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚·鲁普当时17岁。

sentences.en: When questioned by police, she said she didn't know if her father had come home that night.
sentences.zh: 当被警方询问时，她说她不知道父亲那天晚上是否回过家。

sentences.en: It was only when they told her that her mother had confessed to killing Rudolf that Andrea changed her story.
sentences.zh: 直到警方告诉她，她母亲已经承认杀害了鲁道夫，安德烈亚才改变了说法。

sentences.en: It was a watershed moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个转折点。

sentences.en: Andrea admitted that Rudolf had come home after drinking at the clubhouse, but she added a significant detail.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚承认鲁道夫在俱乐部喝完酒后回到了家，但她补充了一个重要的细节。

sentences.en: She claimed that her father had been sexually abusing her for years.
sentences.zh: 她声称父亲多年来一直对她进行性虐待。

sentences.en: It happened again that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上又发生了同样的事。

sentences.en: Afterwards, a fight broke out between her parents and her mother pushed Rudolf down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 事后，她的父母之间爆发了争吵，母亲将鲁道夫推下了楼梯。

sentences.en: Armed with these confessions, an extensive forensic search was carried out at the Rook's farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 掌握了这些供词后，警方对鲁普家的农舍进行了大规模的法医搜查。

sentences.en: According to Hermina, when Rudolf landed at the bottom of the stairs, a pool of blood formed under his body which she had cleaned up.
sentences.zh: 据赫米娜所说，当鲁道夫摔在楼梯底部时，他的身下形成了一滩血迹，她已经清理过了。

sentences.en: Yet, the search of the farmhouse failed to uncover a single trace of blood.
sentences.zh: 然而，对农舍的搜查并没有发现任何血迹。

sentences.en: Manuela's fiancé, Matthias, whose surname has been withheld from the public due to Germany's privacy laws, was now 20 years old.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉的未婚夫马蒂亚斯，由于德国隐私法的原因，其姓氏未向公众公开，当时他20岁。

sentences.en: Matthias initially denied knowing anything about Rudolf's disappearance, but it only took him a few hours to crack.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯起初否认知道鲁道夫失踪的任何情况，但没过几个小时他就崩溃了。

sentences.en: He admitted that Hermina had killed Rudolf and that he'd helped her dispose of his body and car in that eager time at Pond.
sentences.zh: 他承认是赫米娜杀害了鲁道夫，并且他曾在那个急切的时刻帮她在池塘处理了尸体和汽车。

sentences.en: However, Matthias made no mention of Rudolf being pushed down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 然而，马蒂亚斯只字未提鲁道夫被推下楼梯的事。

sentences.en: He said Hermina had beat Rudolf to death with a club.
sentences.zh: 他说赫米娜是用棍子把鲁道夫打死的。

sentences.en: Not only did this contradict the statements from Rudolf's wife and daughters, it made the lack of blood spatter in the Rook farmhouse even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 这不仅与鲁道夫妻子和女儿们的陈述相矛盾，还让鲁普家农舍内缺乏血迹喷溅的情况变得更加令人费解。

sentences.en: Despite the lack of forensic evidence, the confessions couldn't be ignored.
sentences.zh: 尽管缺乏法医证据，但这些供词不容忽视。

sentences.en: Hermina, Manuela, Andrea and Matthias were all charged with manslaughter and held in custody as the prosecutor continued building his case against them.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜、曼努埃拉、安德烈亚和马蒂亚斯都被控过失杀人罪并被拘留，检察官继续针对他们收集证据。

sentences.en: One week after her original confession, Hermina Rook spoke to the investigators again.
sentences.zh: 在最初供述一周后，赫米娜·鲁普再次与调查人员进行了交谈。

sentences.en: This time, she withdrew her entire confession.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她撤回了全部供词。

sentences.en: Hermina adamantly denied that Rudolf had ever come home on the night he went missing and maintained that she had no idea what happened to him.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜坚决否认鲁道夫在失踪当晚回过家，并坚持称她不知道他发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Two days later, Andrea also retracted her story about her mother pushing Rudolf down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 两天后，安德烈亚也撤回了关于她母亲将鲁道夫推下楼梯的说法。

sentences.en: According to Andrea, what really happened was that Hermina and Matthias had beaten Rudolf to death with a club.
sentences.zh: 据安德烈亚所说，真实情况是赫米娜和马蒂亚斯用棍子将鲁道夫打死了。

sentences.en: She later changed her story again, saying it wasn't a club, but a hammer.
sentences.zh: 她后来又改口说不是棍子，而是锤子。

sentences.en: The Rooks were taken to their farmhouse to participate in a videotape to reconstruction of the crime scene in the hopes a clearer picture of the truth would emerge.
sentences.zh: 鲁普一家被带回农舍参加犯罪现场的录像重建，希望能还原出更清晰的真相。

sentences.en: On camera, Manuela made a sudden switch from her original story.
sentences.zh: 在镜头前，曼努埃拉突然推翻了她最初的说法。

sentences.en: Instead of describing how her mother had pushed her father down the stairs, she claimed that her fiancé, Matthias, had beaten Rudolf to death with a wooden club.
sentences.zh: 她没有描述母亲如何将父亲推下楼梯，而是声称她的未婚夫马蒂亚斯用木棍将鲁道夫打死了。

sentences.en: At first, Manuela said that Matthias was the sole perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 起初，曼努埃拉说马蒂亚斯是唯一的肇事者。

sentences.en: Later that day, she said her mother had also participated in the beating.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，她说她母亲也参与了殴打。

sentences.en: Using a police mannequin, Manuela demonstrated the way Hermina had whacked Rudolf in the head several times before Matthias took over.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉用一个警用人体模型演示了赫米娜如何在马蒂亚斯接手前，多次击打鲁道夫的头部。

sentences.en: She didn't know how many times Rudolf was struck overall, but one thing she was certain of was that there was a lot of blood.
sentences.zh: 她不知道鲁道夫总共被击打了多少次，但她确定的一点是，现场有很多血。

sentences.en: Then, in mid-February, Manuela changed her story yet again.
sentences.zh: 接着，在二月中旬，曼努埃拉又一次改变了说法。

sentences.en: She claimed that her mother had nothing to do with the death of her father and that Matthias had acted alone.
sentences.zh: 她声称她母亲与父亲的死无关，是马蒂亚斯一人所为。

sentences.en: After beating Rudolf to death, she said Matthias cut up Rudolf's corpse and fed it to their pet dogs, which included Dobermans, a bull terrier and a German shepherd.
sentences.zh: 她说马蒂亚斯在将鲁道夫打死后，将他的尸体切碎并喂给了他们的宠物狗，其中包括杜宾犬、斗牛梗和德国牧羊犬。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before Andrea also submitted another version of events.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，安德烈亚也提交了另一个版本的事件经过。

sentences.en: She maintained that her father had come home and sexually abused her, but this time she added that Matthias found out what was going on and came to her defence.
sentences.zh: 她坚持说父亲回家后曾性虐待她，但这次她补充说马蒂亚斯发现了这件事并为她出头。

sentences.en: According to Andrea, Matthias threw Rudolf down the stairs, killing him.
sentences.zh: 据安德烈亚所说，马蒂亚斯将鲁道夫推下楼梯，导致其死亡。

sentences.en: He then disposed of both Rudolf's body and vehicle.
sentences.zh: 随后他处理了鲁道夫的尸体和车辆。

sentences.en: A month later, Andrea said this story wasn't true either.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，安德烈亚说这个版本也不是真的。

sentences.en: She said that Hermina and Matthias had attacked Rudolf on the staircase, after which they cut his corpse into pieces and fed it to the dogs.
sentences.zh: 她说赫米娜和马蒂亚斯在楼梯上袭击了鲁道夫，之后他们将尸体切成碎片喂了狗。

sentences.en: Investigators struggled to make sense of all the stories.
sentences.zh: 调查人员很难理清所有这些说法。

sentences.en: Of the foursome, Matthias was the only one who stuck by his initial version of events, that Hermina had beaten Rudolf to death with a club,
sentences.zh: 在这四人中，只有马蒂亚斯坚持他最初的说法，即赫米娜用棍子将鲁道夫打死，

sentences.en: after which he'd helped push Rudolf and his car into the eager-timer pond.
sentences.zh: 之后他帮忙将鲁道夫及其汽车推入了急切池塘。

sentences.en: That was until three months later, when Matthias admitted he'd been lying all along.
sentences.zh: 直到三个月后，马蒂亚斯承认他一直都在撒谎。

sentences.en: According to Matthias, when Rudolf returned home in the early hours of October 13, 2001, he approached his future father-in-law in the stairwell.
sentences.zh: 据马蒂亚斯所说，当鲁道夫在2001年10月13日凌晨回到家时，他在楼梯间接近了他未来的岳父。

sentences.en: Using a wooden club, Matthias hit Rudolf from behind and then dragged his body down into the basement.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯用一根木棍从背后击打鲁道夫，然后将他的尸体拖到了地下室。

sentences.en: Matthias was sure Rudolf was dead until he saw his leg twitch.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯本以为鲁道夫已经死了，直到他看到他的腿抽动了一下。

sentences.en: That's when he grabbed a hammer and repeatedly smashed it into Rudolf's temple.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他抓起一把锤子，反复猛击鲁道夫的太阳穴。

sentences.en: He only stopped when it became stuck.
sentences.zh: 直到锤子卡住他才停手。

sentences.en: From there, Matthias dragged Rudolf onto a piece of timber.
sentences.zh: 此后，马蒂亚斯将鲁道夫拖到一块木板上。

sentences.en: He used a hacksaw and a hand axe to sever Rudolf's arms and legs.
sentences.zh: 他用钢锯和手斧切断了鲁道夫的手臂和腿。

sentences.en: He cut Rudolf's body open, removed his internal organs, and used a margarine container to scoop all of the blood into a bucket.
sentences.zh: 他剖开了鲁道夫的身体，取出了内脏，并用一个黄油盒将所有的血舀进了一个桶里。

sentences.en: He wrapped the body parts in a garbage bag and carried them out to the tool shed.
sentences.zh: 他用垃圾袋包裹住尸块，并将它们搬到了工具棚。

sentences.en: Matthias then boiled up a pot of water and placed Rudolf's head inside.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯随后烧了一锅水，把鲁道夫的头放了进去。

sentences.en: One investigator asked him why.
sentences.zh: 一名调查人员问他为什么这样做。

sentences.en: Matthias responded,
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯回答说：

sentences.en: Because I thought it might fall apart easier to hack it.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这样更容易把它剁碎。

sentences.en: Once the skull was boiled, Matthias claimed he smashed it into pieces and mixed it into the manure pile on the property.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯声称，头骨煮好后，他将其砸碎并混入了农场的粪堆中。

sentences.en: The remaining body parts were fed to the pet dogs.
sentences.zh: 剩下的尸块则喂给了宠物狗。

sentences.en: Matthias told interviewing officers,
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯告诉审讯人员：

sentences.en: Even when using the most advanced technology available, investigators were still unable to uncover any traces of blood or other forensic evidence anywhere in the Rupp's farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 即使使用了现有的最先进技术，调查人员仍无法在鲁普家的农舍任何地方发现任何血迹或其他法医证据。

sentences.en: Matthias provided an explanation for this.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯对此给出了一个解释。

sentences.en: When he fatally hit Rudolf in the head, he claimed it didn't create an open wound.
sentences.zh: 他声称当他致命地击打鲁道夫头部时，并没有造成开放性伤口。

sentences.en: Investigators repeatedly asked him,
sentences.zh: 调查人员反复问他：

sentences.en: Did you see any blood?
sentences.zh: 你看到血了吗？

sentences.en: Matthias shook his head.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯摇了摇头。

sentences.en: The investigators pressed on, asking,
sentences.zh: 调查人员继续追问：

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 一点都没有吗？

sentences.en: Matthias shook his head again, reiterating,
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯再次摇头，重申道：

sentences.en: No, there was no blood.
sentences.zh: 没有，没有血。

sentences.en: The manure from the farm had been sold to a neighbouring farmer who had since used it to spread over his fields.
sentences.zh: 农场的粪肥已经被卖给了一位邻近的农民，他随后将其撒在了自己的田地里。

sentences.en: A search of the farmer's property turned up 150 pieces of bone.
sentences.zh: 对该农民土地的搜查发现了150块骨头。

sentences.en: None were determined to be human.
sentences.zh: 经鉴定，没有一块是人类的。

sentences.en: Over the coming months, things only got more complicated.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，情况变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: Matthias claimed that both Hermina and Manuela had encouraged the attack while also participating in the beating.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯声称赫米娜和曼努埃拉不仅鼓励了这次袭击，还参与了殴打。

sentences.en: He then retracted this, saying he'd acted alone.
sentences.zh: 随后他又撤回了这一说法，称是他一人所为。

sentences.en: Manuela later said she was the one who had killed her father by beating his skull with a hammer.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉后来称，是她用锤子敲碎父亲的头骨杀死了他。

sentences.en: She claimed Matthias then got rid of Rudolf's body by burning his remains.
sentences.zh: 她声称马蒂亚斯随后通过焚烧遗体处理了鲁道夫的尸体。

sentences.en: Manuela flip-flopped between several versions of events, also stating that her father had been sexually abusing her since she was 12 years old.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉在多个版本之间反复摇摆，还声称父亲从她12岁起就一直在性虐待她。

sentences.en: By October 2004, 10 months after being taken into custody, the stories of all four of the accused finally aligned, but not in the way investigators were hoping.
sentences.zh: 到2004年10月，即被拘留10个月后，所有四名被告的说法终于达成了一致，但并非调查人员所希望的那样。

sentences.en: Hermina, Manuela, Andrea and Matthias had all sought proper legal counsel.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜、曼努埃拉、安德烈亚和马蒂亚斯都寻求了正式的法律咨询。

sentences.en: All four of them now claimed the police had pressured them to submit false confessions.
sentences.zh: 他们四人现在都声称警方曾向他们施压，要求他们做出虚假供词。

sentences.en: Afraid of the repercussions, they complied.
sentences.zh: 由于害怕后果，他们选择了顺从。

sentences.en: Hermina, Manuela, Andrea and Matthias all denied having anything to do with Rudolf Ruck's death and formally withdrew their confessions altogether.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜、曼努埃拉、安德烈亚和马蒂亚斯都否认与鲁道夫·鲁普的死有任何关系，并正式撤回了所有供词。

sentences.en: The whole situation was a complete mess for investigators.
sentences.zh: 整个局面让调查人员感到非常棘手。

sentences.en: Although they didn't know which version of events was the right one, they had no doubt that the group was responsible for Rudolf's death.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们不知道哪个版本才是真相，但他们毫无疑问，该团伙应对鲁道夫的死负责。

sentences.en: Matthias had provided some insight regarding the conflicting confessions.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯曾就这些相互矛盾的供词提供了一些见解。

sentences.en: He said that after killing Rudolf, the group sat down and discussed what to do if the police came poking around.
sentences.zh: 他说在杀害鲁道夫后，这群人坐下来讨论如果警察来盘问该怎么办。

sentences.en: They agreed to say that Rudolf had never come home after drinking at the BSV.
sentences.zh: 他们商定好说鲁道夫在BSV喝完酒后就没回家。

sentences.en: If police didn't believe them, they would say his death had been the result of an accident.
sentences.zh: 如果警察不相信，他们就说他的死是一场意外。

sentences.en: It was possible that the varying confessions had become a confused combination of the fabricated stories and the truth.
sentences.zh: 这些不同的供词很可能已经变成了编造的故事与真相的混乱结合体。

sentences.en: There was also the question of motive.
sentences.zh: 此外还有一个动机问题。

sentences.en: Rudolf had no life insurance, so no one in his family stood to benefit financially from his death.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫没有购买人寿保险，所以他的家人中没有人能从他的死亡中获得经济利益。

sentences.en: Piecing together the circumstantial evidence, investigators ultimately deduced that things had become unbearable in the Rupp household.
sentences.zh: 通过拼凑间接证据，调查人员最终推断鲁普家的情况已经变得令人无法忍受。

sentences.en: Rudolf was constantly drunk and unpleasant to be around.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫经常酗酒，且为人令人不快。

sentences.en: The financial problems were causing a great strain on Rudolf and Hermina's marriage, which was exacerbated by Rudolf's hesitation to sell off more of his farmland.
sentences.zh: 经济问题给鲁道夫和赫米娜的婚姻造成了巨大压力，而鲁道夫不愿出售更多农田的行为加剧了这种矛盾。

sentences.en: For Rudolf's daughters, they could no longer endure the ongoing sexual abuse, which continued even after Matthias moved in with them.
sentences.zh: 对于鲁道夫的女儿们来说，她们再也无法忍受持续的性虐待，这种虐待甚至在马蒂亚斯搬进来后仍在继续。

sentences.en: The fact that Rudolf didn't get along with Matthias was the final nail in the coffin.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫与马蒂亚斯不和的事实成了压死骆驼的最后一根稻草。

sentences.en: It didn't matter that they wouldn't gain financially.
sentences.zh: 他们是否能获得经济利益并不重要。

sentences.en: The family simply wanted Rudolf out of the picture.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭只是想让鲁道夫消失。

sentences.en: Prosecutors believed the most likely scenario was that Rudolf's family had waited for him to return home from the BSV clubhouse that October night.
sentences.zh: 检察官认为最可能的情况是，鲁道夫的家人在那个十月的夜晚等待他从BSV俱乐部回家。

sentences.en: Once he was inside, Matthias ambushed Rudolf in the stairwell, hitting him from behind with a wooden club.
sentences.zh: 他一进门，马蒂亚斯就在楼梯间伏击了鲁道夫，用木棍从背后击打他。

sentences.en: Hermina, Manuela and Andrea stood nearby, cheering Matthias on while also hurling abuse at Rudolf.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜、曼努埃拉和安德烈亚站在一旁，为马蒂亚斯加油助威，同时对鲁道夫进行辱骂。

sentences.en: As Rudolf laid defenceless on the ground, Hermina also hit him in the head, while Manuela and Andrea kicked him in the body.
sentences.zh: 当鲁道夫无助地躺在地上时，赫米娜也击打了他的头部，而曼努埃拉和安德烈亚则踢了他的身体。

sentences.en: Once they thought he was dead, the group heaved his body into the basement, only to realise he was still alive.
sentences.zh: 当他们以为他死了时，这群人将他的尸体抬进地下室，却发现他还活着。

sentences.en: Matthias took care of this by hitting him in the temple with a hammer.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯用锤子猛击他的太阳穴解决了这个问题。

sentences.en: They left his body there until the next morning, at which point Matthias and Hermina dismembered his body and disposed of his remains before reporting Rudolf missing.
sentences.zh: 他们把尸体留在那里直到第二天早上，随后马蒂亚斯和赫米娜分尸并处理了遗体，之后才报告鲁道夫失踪。

sentences.en: This just left one question.
sentences.zh: 这只留下了一个问题。

sentences.en: Where was Rudolf's Mercedes?
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫的奔驰车在哪里？

sentences.en: Igotsheimer Pond was a popular recreation spot for swimming, kayaking and sunbathing.
sentences.zh: 伊戈茨海默池塘是一个受欢迎的游泳、皮划艇和日光浴休闲场所。

sentences.en: Its murky waters had been explored during previous searches for Rudolf, but nothing was found.
sentences.zh: 在之前的搜寻中，人们曾探索过它浑浊的水域，但一无所获。

sentences.en: Matthias pinpointed the location where he and Hermina claimed to have pushed the vehicle in, but the car wasn't there either.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯指出了他和赫米娜声称推入车辆的位置，但车也不在那里。

sentences.en: In another version of his story, Matthias said that he'd disposed of Rudolf's Mercedes in a scrapyard.
sentences.zh: 在另一个版本的供词中，马蒂亚斯说他把鲁道夫的奔驰车处理到了一个废品回收站。

sentences.en: Although he didn't say which one, investigators suspected they knew.
sentences.zh: 虽然他没说具体是哪一个，但调查人员怀疑他们知道。

sentences.en: Ludwig Hecht was a scrap dealer who lived near the Rupp's residence and was known to frequent their farm.
sentences.zh: 路德维希·赫希特是一位住在鲁普家附近并经常出入他们农场的废品回收商。

sentences.en: Hecht was well known to the police, with an extensive criminal rap sheet dating back to the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 赫希特在警方那里很有名，有着自20世纪60年代以来的大量犯罪记录。

sentences.en: He also owned a scrap pressing machine, giving him the means to dispose of a vehicle.
sentences.zh: 他还拥有一台废品压制机，这使他有能力处理一辆汽车。

sentences.en: Ludwig Hecht was taken in for questioning, but denied having anything to do with Rudolf Rupp's car.
sentences.zh: 路德维希·赫希特被带去审讯，但否认与鲁道夫·鲁普的车有任何关系。

sentences.en: Detectives weren't convinced.
sentences.zh: 侦探们并不相信。

sentences.en: Hecht had once been part of a notorious criminal gang and was known to bear hatred towards the police.
sentences.zh: 赫希特曾是一个臭名昭著的犯罪团伙的成员，并以仇视警察而闻名。

sentences.en: Given the lack of forensic evidence found at the Rupp property, the possibility that Ludwig Hecht could have helped dispose of Rudolf's body was also considered.
sentences.zh: 鉴于在鲁普家房产中缺乏法医证据，路德维希·赫希特可能协助处理了鲁道夫尸体的可能性也被考虑在内。

sentences.en: A search of Hecht's scrapyard didn't reveal anything to tie him to the crime.
sentences.zh: 对赫希特废品回收站的搜查并没有发现任何将他与犯罪联系起来的证据。

sentences.en: But police did find that Hecht had been improperly storing a number of pollutants.
sentences.zh: 但警方确实发现赫希特一直在违规储存一些污染物。

sentences.en: This was considered an environmental violation and carried a hefty fine.
sentences.zh: 这被视为环境违规，并面临巨额罚款。

sentences.en: Faced with this offence, there were hopes that Hecht might talk in exchange for some kind of deal.
sentences.zh: 面对这一罪名，人们希望赫希特可能会为了某种交易而开口。

sentences.en: He was held in custody for four months and interrogated multiple times as the prosecution continued to build their case against the accused.
sentences.zh: 他被拘留了四个月并多次接受审讯，同时检方继续针对被告收集证据。

sentences.en: But Hecht never swayed from his story that he had nothing to do with Rudolf Rupp's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 但赫希特从未动摇过他的说法，即他与鲁道夫·鲁普的失踪无关。

sentences.en: He was eventually released and charged with an 8,000 euro fine in relation to the misstored chemicals.
sentences.zh: 他最终被释放，并因化学品储存不当被处以8000欧元的罚款。

sentences.en: In the lead up to the trial, Hermina Rupp and her two daughters were presented with an option.
sentences.zh: 在审判前夕，赫米娜·鲁普和她的两个女儿得到了一个选择。

sentences.en: Confess to the truth and they would all serve their sentences in the same prison.
sentences.zh: 坦白真相，她们就可以在同一所监狱服刑。

sentences.en: But they didn't budge from their story that they'd given false confessions under pressure from the police.
sentences.zh: 但她们坚持认为自己在警方的压力下做出了虚假供词，没有动摇。

sentences.en: The manslaughter trial commenced in April 2005.
sentences.zh: 过失杀人案审判于2005年4月开始。

sentences.en: The prosecution case relied heavily on the defendant's retracted confessions.
sentences.zh: 检方的案件很大程度上依赖于被告撤回的供词。

sentences.en: Videos were played of the accused as they took police through a reenactment of their alleged crimes.
sentences.zh: 法庭播放了被告带领警方重演所谓犯罪过程的录像。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that each story contradicted the other, the prosecution linked them to form a consistent factual event.
sentences.zh: 尽管每个故事都相互矛盾，但检方将它们串联起来，形成了一个连贯的事实事件。

sentences.en: A forensic pathologist provided an explanation for the lack of blood spatter or DNA found at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 一位法医病理学家对犯罪现场缺乏血迹喷溅或DNA的情况给出了合理解释。

sentences.en: They explained that both the killing of Rudolf and the dismemberment could have been relatively bloodless and that there probably wasn't any spurting bleeding.
sentences.zh: 他们解释说，杀害鲁道夫和分尸的过程可能相对无血，可能并没有喷射状出血。

sentences.en: Cleaning measures would have been adequate to remove all traces.
sentences.zh: 清理措施足以清除所有痕迹。

sentences.en: The pathologist believed that the descriptions of the attack originally provided by the accused sounded completely plausible, albeit lacking in detail.
sentences.zh: 病理学家认为，被告最初提供的袭击描述听起来完全可信，尽管缺乏细节。

sentences.en: There was just one thing they weren't sure about.
sentences.zh: 只有一件事他们不确定。

sentences.en: Part of the prosecution's case was that Matthias had crushed Rudolf's bones and buried them in the manure pile.
sentences.zh: 检方案件的一部分是马蒂亚斯粉碎了鲁道夫的骨头并将其埋在粪堆里。

sentences.en: According to the pathologist, if this was true, at the very least residue of the bones would have remained.
sentences.zh: 据病理学家所说，如果这是真的，至少会残留骨头残渣。

sentences.en: The defence described any statements made by their clients as pure imagination.
sentences.zh: 辩方将他们当事人所做的任何陈述描述为纯粹的想象。

sentences.en: They blamed the false confessions on the fact that their clients were all of below average intelligence
sentences.zh: 他们将虚假供词归咎于他们的当事人智力均低于平均水平这一事实，

sentences.en: and therefore didn't have the mental capacity to withstand the pressure of the interrogations.
sentences.zh: 因此没有心理能力承受审讯的压力。

sentences.en: The four accused had IQs ranging between 53 and 71.
sentences.zh: 这四名被告的智商在53到71之间。

sentences.en: They were also initially questioned at length without any legal representation, making them, quote,
sentences.zh: 他们最初还在没有法律代理的情况下接受了长时间的审讯，这使得他们，引用原话：

sentences.en: These preliminary interrogations hadn't been recorded, meaning there was no way to know what was discussed during this crucial time before the official interrogations commenced.
sentences.zh: 这些初步审讯没有被记录，这意味着无法得知在正式审讯开始前的这段关键时间内讨论了什么。

sentences.en: According to Matthias, it was only after the police threatened him with violence that he made up the story about dismembering Rudolf's body.
sentences.zh: 据马蒂亚斯所说，是在警方威胁要对他施暴后，他才编造了关于分尸鲁道夫尸体的故事。

sentences.en: Investigators testifying at the trial firmly denied this.
sentences.zh: 在审判中作证的调查人员坚决否认了这一点。

sentences.en: After 23 days of testimony, the court agreed that the confessions were real and all four of the accused were declared guilty.
sentences.zh: 经过23天的证词陈述，法院认定供词是真实的，四名被告均被判有罪。

sentences.en: The judge announced,
sentences.zh: 法官宣布：

sentences.en: The terrible act was proven by the many statements.
sentences.zh: 这一可怕的行径已由多项陈述证实。

sentences.en: All in all, it turns out there was a clear and essentially consistent picture, so that there can be no doubt as to the truth.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，事实证明存在一个清晰且基本一致的图景，因此对真相不应有任何怀疑。

sentences.en: No one can seriously believe that the horrific descriptions were made up by the accused.
sentences.zh: 没有人能认真相信这些可怕的描述是被告编造出来的。

sentences.en: Hermina and Matthias were each handed eight-year sentences.
sentences.zh: 赫米娜和马蒂亚斯各被判处八年监禁。

sentences.en: Manuela and Andrea, who were being tried as juveniles, weren't found guilty of manslaughter, but of aiding and abetting.
sentences.zh: 作为未成年人受审的曼努埃拉和安德烈亚，未被判过失杀人罪，而是被判从犯罪。

sentences.en: They were sentenced to three and a half and two and a half years in youth detention, respectively.
sentences.zh: 他们分别被判处三年半和两年半的青少年拘留。

sentences.en: Following the verdict, a report handed down by the judge provided another possible explanation for the lack of forensic evidence.
sentences.zh: 判决下达后，法官提交的一份报告为缺乏法医证据提供了另一种可能的解释。

sentences.en: The report said,
sentences.zh: 报告称，

sentences.en: The court is considering the possibility that the defendant could have fed the remaining body parts to the pigs.
sentences.zh: 法院正在考虑被告可能已将剩余的尸块喂给了猪。

sentences.en: The chamber is aware that pigs, being omnivores, would also eat the rest of the body parts, including the bones.
sentences.zh: 法庭意识到，猪作为杂食动物，也会吃掉其余的尸块，包括骨头。

sentences.en: It is quite conceivable that feeding the pigs constitutes an even more terrifying disposal of the corpse for the defendant than throwing it in the manure heap,
sentences.zh: 完全可以想象，对于被告来说，喂猪比把尸体扔进粪堆是一种更可怕的处置方式，

sentences.en: since the pigs are ultimately eaten by humans as part of the human food chain.
sentences.zh: 因为猪最终会作为人类食物链的一部分被人类食用。

sentences.en: There is a possibility that the pigs have even been eaten by the family themselves.
sentences.zh: 甚至存在猪已经被这家人自己吃掉的可能性。

sentences.en: Four years passed, during which Manuela and Andrea served their time and began to move on with their lives as they waited for their mother's release.
sentences.zh: 四年过去了，曼努埃拉和安德烈亚在服刑期间开始继续她们的生活，等待母亲获释。

sentences.en: In February 2009, a surveyor from a hydroelectric power plant was conducting a routine inspection of the Dunau Reservoir in the municipality of Berkheim.
sentences.zh: 2009年2月，一名来自水力发电厂的测量员正在对伯克海姆市的多瑙河水库进行例行检查。

sentences.en: Using a sonar device to scan the waters beneath his boat, he detected two objects.
sentences.zh: 他使用声纳设备扫描船下的水域，探测到了两个物体。

sentences.en: Closer inspection revealed them both to be cars.
sentences.zh: 进一步检查发现它们都是汽车。

sentences.en: As was routine, the police were notified so that the cars could be salvaged.
sentences.zh: 按照惯例，警方接到通知以便打捞这些车辆。

sentences.en: On Tuesday March 10, a police diver took to the cold waters and identified the first car to be an old Opel cadet.
sentences.zh: 3月10日星期二，一名警用潜水员潜入冰冷的水中，确认第一辆车是一辆旧欧宝卡德特。

sentences.en: He swam down for a second time.
sentences.zh: 他第二次潜入水中。

sentences.en: Through the murky waters, he recognised the unmistakable shape of a three-pointed star, the Mercedes brand emblem.
sentences.zh: 透过浑浊的水域，他认出了那个标志性的三叉星形状，那是梅赛德斯的品牌标志。

sentences.en: The diver swam to the rear of the submerged vehicle.
sentences.zh: 潜水员游到沉没车辆的后部。

sentences.en: The licence plate was covered in algae.
sentences.zh: 车牌上覆盖着藻类。

sentences.en: He scraped it off and got a closer look.
sentences.zh: 他刮掉藻类，仔细观察。

sentences.en: Though visibility was poor, he could make out what it said.
sentences.zh: 虽然能见度很差，但他还是辨认出了上面的字样。

sentences.en: ND AE 265.
sentences.zh: ND AE 265。

sentences.en: It was Rudolf Rupp's car.
sentences.zh: 那是鲁道夫·鲁普的车。

sentences.en: And behind the wheel was Rudolf's body.
sentences.zh: 而在驾驶座后面的是鲁道夫的尸体。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案卷》节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案卷》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Word of the discovery quickly reached the press.
sentences.zh: 这一发现的消息很快传到了媒体耳中。

sentences.en: Camera crews and reporters watched as search and rescue divers disappeared under the water to attach a rope to the rear axle of Rudolf's Mercedes.
sentences.zh: 摄像组和记者们注视着搜救潜水员消失在水下，将绳索系在鲁道夫梅赛德斯的后轴上。

sentences.en: On the riverbank, a crane started hauling the vehicle out of the water.
sentences.zh: 在河岸上，一台起重机开始将车辆从水中吊起。

sentences.en: To the experienced rescue crews watching on, it was clear that the crane was lifting the car at too high of an angle.
sentences.zh: 对于在场的经验丰富的救援人员来说，很明显起重机吊起汽车的角度太高了。

sentences.en: They tried to alert the driver, but it was too late.
sentences.zh: 他们试图提醒操作员，但为时已晚。

sentences.en: With the front of the vehicle pointing downwards, the dense mud that packed the inside of the car shot forwards, causing the windscreen to shatter and burst out.
sentences.zh: 随着车头向下倾斜，塞在车内密实的淤泥向前涌动，导致挡风玻璃破碎并爆裂开来。

sentences.en: Masses of mud rushed back into the water, taking Rudolf's body with it.
sentences.zh: 大量的淤泥冲回水中，带走了鲁道夫的尸体。

sentences.en: After a frantic search, divers managed to fish the corpse out of the murky waters.
sentences.zh: 经过一番疯狂的搜寻，潜水员终于从浑浊的水中打捞出了尸体。

sentences.en: With Rudolf's body safe on shore, investigators were stunned.
sentences.zh: 当鲁道夫的尸体安全地放在岸上时，调查人员惊呆了。

sentences.en: The cold water of the Dunau had preserved his remains fairly well.
sentences.zh: 多瑙河冰冷的水将他的遗体保存得相当完好。

sentences.en: While some parts had been eaten by fish, Rudolf's body was mostly intact.
sentences.zh: 虽然有些部位被鱼吃掉了，但鲁道夫的尸体大部分还是完整的。

sentences.en: And there were no obvious injuries.
sentences.zh: 而且没有明显的伤痕。

sentences.en: An autopsy confirmed that Rudolf's skull was completely unharmed.
sentences.zh: 尸检证实鲁道夫的头骨完全没有受到损伤。

sentences.en: There was no sign of bleeding in his brain or any other head injury.
sentences.zh: 他的大脑没有出血迹象，也没有其他头部损伤。

sentences.en: Although the flesh on Rudolf's neck was no longer intact, his torso and spine were completely unharmed.
sentences.zh: 虽然鲁道夫颈部的肉已经不完整了，但他的躯干和脊椎完全没有受到损伤。

sentences.en: There was no sign of internal bleeding or cardiac arreSt.
sentences.zh: 没有内出血或心脏骤停的迹象。

sentences.en: Toxicology tests revealed no traces of poison or other drugs, although it was possible that any toxic substances had been washed out after years underwater.
sentences.zh: 毒理学测试没有发现毒药或其他药物的痕迹，尽管有毒物质可能在水下多年后已被冲刷殆尽。

sentences.en: Ultimately, it was unclear whether Rudolf had still been alive when he entered the water, and the cause of his death couldn't be determined.
sentences.zh: 最终，鲁道夫进入水中时是否还活着尚不清楚，死因也无法确定。

sentences.en: One thing was certain.
sentences.zh: 有一点是肯定的。

sentences.en: Rudolf hadn't been beaten to death, nor had he fatally fallen down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫不是被殴打致死的，也没有从楼梯上摔下致死。

sentences.en: He hadn't been shot or stabbed, and he certainly hadn't been dismembered and fed to the farm animals.
sentences.zh: 他没有被枪杀或刺伤，当然也没有被肢解并喂给农场动物。

sentences.en: In fact, not a single sign of violence was found anywhere on Rudolf's body.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在鲁道夫的尸体上没有发现任何暴力迹象。

sentences.en: Rudolf's Mercedes was analysed to see if it could shed some light on what happened.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫的梅赛德斯被分析以查明发生了什么。

sentences.en: Two keys were needed for Rudolf's car, one to unlock the doors and another to start the engine.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫的车需要两把钥匙，一把用来开门，另一把用来启动引擎。

sentences.en: One set of keys were found in Rudolf's pocket, but there was no key in the ignition.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫的口袋里发现了一套钥匙，但点火开关里没有钥匙。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the engine showed no signs of water hammer, which is what happens when the drive unit sucks in water instead of air.
sentences.zh: 此外，引擎没有水锤现象，这是驱动装置吸入水而不是空气时发生的情况。

sentences.en: This led one motor vehicle expert to conclude that the engine wasn't running when the vehicle was submerged into the river.
sentences.zh: 这使一位机动车专家得出结论，即车辆沉入河中时引擎并未运转。

sentences.en: However, this didn't necessarily mean that Rudolf's car had been deliberately pushed in.
sentences.zh: 然而，这并不一定意味着鲁道夫的车是被人故意推下去的。

sentences.en: When the Mercedes was hauled from the water, the gearstick was in the park position.
sentences.zh: 当梅赛德斯从水中被拖出时，变速杆处于驻车档位置。

sentences.en: If the engine was off and the car was in park, it would have been near impossible for someone to push it over the embankment.
sentences.zh: 如果引擎熄火且汽车处于驻车档，那么有人将其推过路堤几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: The car could have been towed directly into the water from a trailer, with Rudolf's already deceased or unconscious body inside.
sentences.zh: 汽车可能是从拖车上直接拖入水中的，当时鲁道夫的尸体已经死亡或处于昏迷状态。

sentences.en: But back in April 2004, police divers had already searched the exact spot near the Dunau Reservoir where Rudolf's car was eventually found.
sentences.zh: 但在2004年4月，警方潜水员已经搜查过最终发现鲁道夫汽车的多瑙河水库附近的那个确切地点。

sentences.en: This raised the question of whether it could have been dumped or driven into the water elsewhere and then washed further downstream.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一个问题：它是否是在其他地方被倾倒或开入水中，然后被冲到了下游更远的地方。

sentences.en: The power plant worker who discovered the car didn't think so.
sentences.zh: 发现这辆车的发电厂工人并不这么认为。

sentences.en: The current wasn't strong enough.
sentences.zh: 水流强度不够。

sentences.en: They deemed it much more likely that the car had been missed by mere metres during the original search,
sentences.zh: 他们认为更有可能的是，在最初的搜查中，汽车仅差几米就被错过了，

sentences.en: thus sitting undiscovered at the bottom of the river for a further five years.
sentences.zh: 因此在河底又静静地躺了五年才被发现。

sentences.en: Three weeks after Rudolf's body was found, he was given a church burial in his hometown.
sentences.zh: 在鲁道夫的尸体被发现三周后，他在家乡举行了教堂葬礼。

sentences.en: His wife and daughters were not among the few family members who attended the funeral.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子和女儿们并不在参加葬礼的少数家庭成员之列。

sentences.en: A wooden cross placed on his gravesite said nothing about the events or assumed an accurate timeline of his death, stating simply,
sentences.zh: 放置在他墓地上的木十字架上没有提及这些事件，也没有推断他死亡的准确时间，只是简单地写着：

sentences.en: Rudolf Rupp, 1949-2009.
The discovery of Rudolf's body was the talk of the town.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫尸体的发现成了镇上的谈资。

sentences.en: Media gathered outside the Rupp's vacant, neglected farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 媒体聚集在鲁普家空置、荒废的农舍外。

sentences.en: Hermina Rupp's red Audi was still parked outside, while Hermina herself continued to serve her sentence for her husband's death.
sentences.zh: 赫尔米娜·鲁普的红色奥迪车仍停在外面，而赫尔米娜本人则因丈夫的死继续服刑。

sentences.en: Many assumed that she would be released and that all four of the accused would be acquitted.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为她会被释放，所有四名被告都会被判无罪。

sentences.en: After all, the revoked confessions that had formed a major part of the original verdict had now been proven untrue, and therefore many considered them to be worthless.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，作为最初判决主要依据的被撤回的供词现在已被证明是不真实的，因此许多人认为它们毫无价值。

sentences.en: The discovery of Rudolf's body also raised suspicions about how the confessions came about in the first place.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫尸体的发现也引发了人们对供词最初是如何产生的怀疑。

sentences.en: If the confessions weren't accurate, then how had all four defendants provided a somewhat consistent, albeit muddled, false version of events?
sentences.zh: 如果供词不准确，那么所有四名被告是如何提供了一个虽然混乱但大体一致的虚假事件版本的？

sentences.en: Hermina's defence lawyer, Klaus Wittmann, told Spiegel Online,
sentences.zh: 赫尔米娜的辩护律师克劳斯·维特曼告诉《明镜在线》：

sentences.en: When a corpse fed to dogs suddenly sits in a car in the Dunau, this clearly refutes the confessions of the accused, and thus the basis of the verdict in this case.
sentences.zh: 当一具据称被喂狗的尸体突然出现在多瑙河的一辆车里时，这显然反驳了被告的供词，从而也反驳了本案判决的基础。

sentences.en: Klaus believed that a retrial was essential, saying,
sentences.zh: 克劳斯认为重审至关重要，他说：

sentences.en: Anything else would be a scandal.
sentences.zh: 任何其他结果都是丑闻。

sentences.en: However, the regional judge stated that retrials were only permitted when newly discovered facts could lead to an acquittal.
sentences.zh: 然而，地区法官表示，只有在新发现的事实可能导致无罪判决时，才允许重审。

sentences.en: In this case, he felt the original trial had proven beyond doubt that Rudolf hadn't died by accident or suicide, but had been killed by the four accused.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他认为最初的审判已经毫无疑问地证明了鲁道夫不是死于意外或自杀，而是被四名被告杀害的。

sentences.en: It didn't matter if they'd lied about the way Rudolf was killed or disposed of,
sentences.zh: 他们是否在鲁道夫的死法或尸体处理方式上撒谎并不重要，

sentences.en: their motives remained the same, and their revoked confessions still supported other elements of the crime.
sentences.zh: 他们的动机依然存在，他们被撤回的供词仍然支持犯罪的其他要素。

sentences.en: While the autopsy report found no injuries on Rudolf's spine, the flesh on his neck was no longer intact.
sentences.zh: 虽然尸检报告发现鲁道夫的脊椎没有受伤，但颈部的肉已经不完整了。

sentences.en: According to the pathologist, the possibility that Rudolf had been strangled, suffocated, or had his throat slit, couldn't be ruled out.
sentences.zh: 据病理学家称，不能排除鲁道夫被勒死、窒息或割喉的可能性。

sentences.en: When Rudolf's body was initially discovered, he was kneeling in the driver's seat, facing towards the rear of the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 当鲁道夫的尸体最初被发现时，他跪在驾驶座上，面朝车辆后部。

sentences.en: The pathologist believed this strange position could be explained by rigor mortis having already set in when Rudolf's body was placed in the car.
sentences.zh: 病理学家认为，这种奇怪的姿势可以用鲁道夫的尸体被放入车内时已经出现尸僵来解释。

sentences.en: He also said it was possible that Rudolf's body had been kept in a freezer and then placed in the car in a frozen state.
sentences.zh: 他还表示，鲁道夫的尸体可能被保存在冰柜中，然后以冷冻状态放入车内。

sentences.en: Essentially, the judge ruled that it didn't matter how Rudolf had died.
sentences.zh: 本质上，法官裁定鲁道夫是如何死亡的并不重要。

sentences.en: It had already been proven that Hermina, Matthias, Manuela, and Andrea were complicit in killing him.
sentences.zh: 赫尔米娜、马蒂亚斯、曼努埃拉和安德烈亚共谋杀害他这一事实已经得到证实。

sentences.en: Their request for a retrial was rejected.
sentences.zh: 他们的重审请求被驳回。

sentences.en: In November 2009, the now 54-year-old Hermina Rup was released from prison after serving five of her eight-year sentence.
sentences.zh: 2009年11月，现年54岁的赫尔米娜·鲁普在服满八年刑期中的五年后获释。

sentences.en: Her early release had nothing to do with the recovery of her husband's body eight months earlier,
sentences.zh: 她的提前获释与八个月前发现她丈夫的尸体无关，

sentences.en: but was due to her being a first-time offender who was deemed to no longer pose a threat.
sentences.zh: 而是因为她是初犯，被认为不再构成威胁。

sentences.en: Matthias was released shortly after.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯不久后获释。

sentences.en: Although this meant that all four of the accused were now free, their defence team continued to fight for a new trial.
sentences.zh: 虽然这意味着所有四名被告现在都自由了，但他们的辩护团队继续争取重审。

sentences.en: It didn't matter that they'd already served their time.
sentences.zh: 他们是否已经服刑并不重要。

sentences.en: Many believed they had been wrongfully convicted.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为他们被错误地定罪了。

sentences.en: Without a retrial, justice wouldn't prevail and the stigma against them would remain.
sentences.zh: 如果没有重审，正义就无法伸张，针对他们的污名也将持续存在。

sentences.en: As Hermina's lawyer explained, my client doesn't want to be branded a murderer.
sentences.zh: 正如赫尔米娜的律师所解释的那样，我的当事人不想被贴上杀人犯的标签。

sentences.en: An appeal was submitted to the State Supreme Court of Bavaria, where authorities disagreed with the regional judge's ruling that it didn't matter how Rudolph was killed.
sentences.zh: 上诉被提交至巴伐利亚州最高法院，当局不同意地区法官关于鲁道夫如何被杀并不重要的裁决。

sentences.en: The request for a retrial was granted.
sentences.zh: 重审请求获得批准。

sentences.en: Regardless of the outcome, the defendants couldn't be sent back to prison, but it gave them the chance to clear their names.
sentences.zh: 无论结果如何，被告都不能被送回监狱，但这给了他们洗清罪名的机会。

sentences.en: By the time the retrial began in October 2010,
sentences.zh: 到2010年10月重审开始时，

sentences.en: Matthias and Manuela were no longer a couple.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯和曼努埃拉已经不再是情侣了。

sentences.en: The youngest Rup daughter, Andrea, was heavily pregnant and unable to stand trial.
sentences.zh: 鲁普家最小的女儿安德烈亚怀有身孕，无法出庭受审。

sentences.en: The decision was made to continue without her.
sentences.zh: 决定在没有她的情况下继续审理。

sentences.en: The prosecution submitted that the manslaughter conviction for Matthias and Hermina be upheld.
sentences.zh: 检方提议维持对马蒂亚斯和赫尔米娜的过失杀人罪判决。

sentences.en: While the prosecutor admitted that not everything in this process went perfectly and that the investigation had clearly gone awry,
sentences.zh: 虽然检察官承认这个过程并非一切完美，调查显然出了差错，

sentences.en: he said there was no doubt as to what happened to Rudolph Rup in the early morning hours of October 13, 2001.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，对于2001年10月13日凌晨鲁道夫·鲁普身上发生的事情毫无疑问。

sentences.en: The motives presented in the original trial remained unchanged.
sentences.zh: 最初审判中提出的动机保持不变。

sentences.en: Rudolph Rup was an abusive alcoholic and his family wanted him out of the picture.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫·鲁普是一个虐待成性的酒鬼，他的家人想让他消失。

sentences.en: But the method of murder changed based on the new forensic evidence.
sentences.zh: 但谋杀方式根据新的法医证据发生了变化。

sentences.en: After returning home from the BSV Neuborg, the prosecution presented that Hermina pushed Rudolph down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 检方提出，从BSV纽堡回家后，赫尔米娜将鲁道夫推下了楼梯。

sentences.en: As he lay on the landing, Hermina and Matthias beat Rudolph with a wooden plank in the neck area.
sentences.zh: 当他躺在楼梯平台上时，赫尔米娜和马蒂亚斯用一块木板击打鲁道夫的颈部区域。

sentences.en: As per the pathologist's report, it also couldn't be ruled out that they'd strangled Rudolph or slit his throat.
sentences.zh: 根据病理学家的报告，也不能排除他们勒死鲁道夫或割断他喉咙的可能性。

sentences.en: Matthias and Hermina managed to load Rudolph's unconscious body into his car and dispose of it in the Dunau River.
sentences.zh: 马蒂亚斯和赫尔米娜设法将鲁道夫昏迷的身体装进他的车里，并将其弃置在多瑙河中。

sentences.en: The E230 model Mercedes didn't require the key to be in the ignition or the brake to be applied for the gears to be changed.
sentences.zh: E230型梅赛德斯不需要钥匙在点火开关中或踩下刹车即可换档。

sentences.en: The gear stick was also able to be moved very easily during the rescue mission.
sentences.zh: 在救援任务中，变速杆也可以非常容易地移动。

sentences.en: Therefore, it was suggested that the gear could have moved to the park position after the car was already in the water.
sentences.zh: 因此，有人建议档位可能是在车进入水中后才移动到驻车位置的。

sentences.en: Andrea and Manuela likely knew that their father was attacked but didn't know whether he was dead or alive.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚和曼努埃拉可能知道她们的父亲受到了攻击，但不知道他是死是活。

sentences.en: Regardless, all four of the accused agreed to lie to detectives if they came sniffing around.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，所有四名被告都同意如果侦探来盘问，就对他们撒谎。

sentences.en: The prosecution agreed that the daughters be acquitted, even if their knowledge of the crime remained questionable.
sentences.zh: 检方同意让女儿们无罪释放，即使她们对犯罪的知情程度仍有疑问。

sentences.en: The defence team argued that all four of the accused be acquitted and compensated to the sum of 100,000 euros combined for their years of wrongful imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 辩护团队辩称，所有四名被告都应被判无罪，并因多年错误监禁获得总计10万欧元的赔偿。

sentences.en: It wasn't the defence's job to prove how Rudolph died, but simply to prove that their clients weren't involved.
sentences.zh: 证明鲁道夫是如何死亡的不是辩方的工作，而仅仅是证明他们的当事人没有参与其中。

sentences.en: Based on the evidence, they believed a drunken accident or suicide couldn't be ruled out.
sentences.zh: 根据证据，他们认为不能排除醉酒事故或自杀的可能性。

sentences.en: When the car windscreen had smashed during the rescue mission, any other evidence that might have been mixed in with the mud had disappeared into the river.
sentences.zh: 当汽车挡风玻璃在救援任务中破碎时，任何可能混在淤泥中的其他证据都已消失在河中。

sentences.en: Therefore, it was possible that the key had been in the ignition but had been ejected over time and was lost in the mud.
sentences.zh: 因此，钥匙可能一直在点火开关中，但随着时间的推移被弹出并丢失在淤泥中。

sentences.en: The only other items found in Rudolph's Mercedes were his mother's death certificate and a letter from the tax office.
sentences.zh: 在鲁道夫的梅赛德斯中发现的唯一其他物品是他母亲的死亡证明和一封来自税务局的信。

sentences.en: The defence team believed this added weight to the theory that Rudolph had taken his own life.
sentences.zh: 辩护团队认为这增加了鲁道夫自杀这一理论的分量。

sentences.en: Diaries owned by Andrea and Manuela had been taken by police during the initial murder investigation.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚和曼努埃拉拥有的日记在最初的谋杀调查中被警方没收了。

sentences.en: There was nothing to indicate either of the girls' guilt in their father's death.
sentences.zh: 没有任何迹象表明这两个女孩在父亲的死中有罪。

sentences.en: On the contrary, in one entry, one of the Rupp daughters had written,
sentences.zh: 相反，在其中一篇日记中，鲁普家的一个女儿写道：

sentences.en: Dad, we need you.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，我们需要你。

sentences.en: Please come back.
sentences.zh: 请回来吧。

sentences.en: Forensic experts concluded that blows to the neck would have only caused a brief loss of consciousness, a few minutes at moSt.
sentences.zh: 法医专家得出结论，颈部受到的打击只会导致短暂的意识丧失，最多几分钟。

sentences.en: One defence lawyer said,
sentences.zh: 一位辩护律师说：

sentences.en: This would hardly allow, under the specific circumstances, to drive a person to the Dunau in a car and to drown in an unconscious state.
sentences.zh: 在特定情况下，这几乎不可能让人开车把一个人送到多瑙河并使其在昏迷状态下溺水身亡。

sentences.en: The defence also counted that if any weight was going to be placed on the since-retracted confessions, at no point in any of those statements
sentences.zh: 辩方还反驳说，如果对自撤回以来的供词有任何采信，那么在这些陈述的任何一点上，

sentences.en: did any of the accused mention a beating to the neck region.
sentences.zh: 都没有任何被告提到过对颈部区域的殴打。

sentences.en: Nor did they ever mention the Dunau River as a dumping ground.
sentences.zh: 他们也从未提到多瑙河是倾倒地点。

sentences.en: As the defence pointed out, the crucial point in the case was whether or not Rudolf Rupp returned home on the night in question, and this couldn't be proven.
sentences.zh: 正如辩方指出的那样，本案的关键点在于鲁道夫·鲁普在事发当晚是否回过家，而这一点无法证明。

sentences.en: Therefore, an accident or suicide could not be ruled out.
sentences.zh: 因此，不能排除事故或自杀的可能性。

sentences.en: The tactics used by police to elicit confessions from the accused were heavily criticised.
sentences.zh: 警方用来诱导被告供词的策略受到了严厉批评。

sentences.en: The defence argued that the original investigators were so convinced they had the right people, they'd asked leading questions in order to extract statements
sentences.zh: 辩方辩称，最初的调查人员如此确信他们抓对了人，以至于他们提出了诱导性问题，以提取出

sentences.en: that supported their belief of what happened to Rudolf.
sentences.zh: 支持他们关于鲁道夫遭遇的信念的陈述。

sentences.en: In none of the original interrogations did any of the accused mention Rudolf falling down the stairs or being fed to the dogs.
sentences.zh: 在最初的所有审讯中，没有任何被告提到鲁道夫从楼梯上摔下来或被喂狗。

sentences.en: It was only after investigators put these scenarios to them that they began to say those events had happened.
sentences.zh: 只有在调查人员向他们提出这些假设后，他们才开始说这些事件发生了。

sentences.en: The fact that the confessions had come out in dribs and drabs and changed over time was proof to the defence of their inaccuracy.
sentences.zh: 供词是零星出现的且随时间而改变这一事实，在辩方看来正是其不准确的证据。

sentences.en: One defence lawyer said,
sentences.zh: 一位辩护律师说：

sentences.en: In my view, the only conceivable way the accused could have come up with these details is that the details were made known by the interrogating officers.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，被告能说出这些细节，唯一合理的解释就是审讯人员向他们透露了这些信息。

sentences.en: A police officer who had obtained Matthias' first confession was asked why a three-hour in-depth preliminary conversation hadn't been recorded.
sentences.zh: 一名负责获取马蒂亚斯首次供词的警官被问及，为何没有对那次长达三小时的深入初步谈话进行录音。

sentences.en: The officer explained that they'd just been getting to know each other.
sentences.zh: 该警官解释说，他们当时只是在互相了解。

sentences.en: It was only when Matthias admitted that Rudolf Rupp had come home on the night in question that the official interrogation began and things were formally documented.
sentences.zh: 直到马蒂亚斯承认鲁道夫·鲁普在案发当晚回过家，正式审讯才开始，相关内容才被正式记录在案。

sentences.en: Interrogation records presented in court showed just how much Manuela's statements contradicted themselves.
sentences.zh: 庭审中出示的审讯记录显示，曼努埃拉的陈述前后矛盾得有多厉害。

sentences.en: Sometimes she said her mother beat her father, other times she made no mention of it.
sentences.zh: 有时她说她母亲殴打她父亲，有时却只字未提。

sentences.en: Manuela testified that she'd only provided these details after the lead investigator provided her with this version of events.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉作证说，她是在首席调查员向她提供了这套事件版本后，才说出这些细节的。

sentences.en: This particular investigator was excused from testifying on the grounds that they were suffering from psychological problems and that being put under intense questioning
sentences.zh: 这位调查员因患有心理疾病，且被认为在严厉盘问下

sentences.en: could trigger severe depressive symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 可能会引发严重的抑郁症状，因此被免于出庭作证。

sentences.en: Later speaking about this decision to the press,
sentences.zh: 后来在向媒体谈及这一决定时，

sentences.en: Manuela's lawyer said,
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉的律师说道：

sentences.en: Who thought about the traumatisation of my client?
sentences.zh: “谁考虑过我当事人的心理创伤？”

sentences.en: The accused mostly sat through the proceedings without showing any emotion.
sentences.zh: 被告在庭审过程中大多表现得面无表情。

sentences.en: That was until a former cellmate of Hermina Rupps took the stand.
sentences.zh: 直到赫尔米娜·鲁普的一位前狱友出庭作证。

sentences.en: She alleged that Hermina had confided to her in prison that Matthias had killed Rudolf using a baseball bat.
sentences.zh: 她声称赫尔米娜在狱中曾向她吐露，马蒂亚斯用棒球棍杀死了鲁道夫。

sentences.en: Hermina, who was in ill health and required a walking frame, got up and left the courtroom in a rage, saying,
sentences.zh: 身体状况不佳、需要助行架支撑的赫尔米娜愤怒地起身离开法庭，说道：

sentences.en: I'm going now.
sentences.zh: “我不干了。”

sentences.en: This is all too stupid for me.
sentences.zh: “这一切对我来说太愚蠢了。”

sentences.en: When she returned, she denied having ever spoken to the woman, calling her a lying pig.
sentences.zh: 当她回来时，她否认曾与该女子交谈，并称对方是“撒谎的猪”。

sentences.en: The former owner of the BSV Neuborg, who had been the last to see Rudolf Rupp alive, testified that after Rudolf went missing,
sentences.zh: BSV纽堡俱乐部的前老板是最后见到鲁道夫·鲁普活着的人，他作证说，在鲁道夫失踪后，

sentences.en: Hermina came to the clubhouse to pay off her husband's tab, but didn't ask anything about his whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 赫尔米娜曾来到俱乐部偿还她丈夫的欠款，但并没有询问过他的下落。

sentences.en: This was in direct contrast to an earlier statement provided by the owner, in which he said Hermina did ask about Rudolf.
sentences.zh: 这与该老板早先提供的一份陈述直接矛盾，在那份陈述中，他说赫尔米娜确实询问过鲁道夫的情况。

sentences.en: Hermina launched forward in her chair, wildly shaking her head and finger at this inconsistency.
sentences.zh: 赫尔米娜在椅子上猛地前倾，对着这一矛盾之处疯狂地摇头并指指点点。

sentences.en: For the prosecution, the fact that Hermina was getting restless was used as further proof of her guilt.
sentences.zh: 对于检方而言，赫尔米娜表现出的焦躁不安被用作她有罪的进一步证据。

sentences.en: Ludwig Hecht, the scrap dealer who had been accused of disposing of Rudolf's Mercedes, also took the stand as a witness for the defence.
sentences.zh: 被指控处理鲁道夫奔驰车的废品收购商路德维希·赫希特也作为辩方证人出庭。

sentences.en: According to Hecht, the police had pressured him to admit he was involved in the crime.
sentences.zh: 据赫希特称，警方曾向他施压，要求他承认自己参与了犯罪。

sentences.en: When he refused to sign a statement admitting to this,
sentences.zh: 当他拒绝签署承认此事的陈述书时，

sentences.en: Hecht alleged that one officer, in the presence of others, held a gun to his head and threatened him, saying,
sentences.zh: 赫希特声称，一名警官在其他人的在场下，用枪指着他的头威胁他说：

sentences.en: this is about murder, we're allowed to do anything.
sentences.zh: “这是谋杀案，我们什么都能做。”

sentences.en: When he still refused to sign it,
sentences.zh: 当他依然拒绝签字时，

sentences.en: Hecht alleged that the lead investigator offered him a deal, admit that Rudolf's Mercedes had been in his scrapyard and the environmental violation against him would be dropped.
sentences.zh: 赫希特声称首席调查员向他提出了一笔交易：承认鲁道夫的奔驰车曾出现在他的废品收购站，针对他的环境违规指控就会被撤销。

sentences.en: The verdict was delivered in February 2011.
sentences.zh: 判决于2011年2月下达。

sentences.en: Based on the kneeling position of Rudolf Rup's body when his Mercedes was found, presiding judge, T.O.
sentences.zh: 基于发现奔驰车时鲁道夫·鲁普尸体的跪姿，审判长T.O.齐格勒法官

sentences.en: Ziegler, ruled out the possibility that Rudolf had died by accident or suicide.
sentences.zh: 排除了鲁道夫死于意外或自杀的可能性。

sentences.en: The fact that his car or wallet weren't stolen were proof that he hadn't been the victim of a random opportunistic attack, but a targeted homicide.
sentences.zh: 他的车和钱包没有被盗，这证明他并非随机机会性袭击的受害者，而是一起有针对性的谋杀。

sentences.en: Judge Ziegler defended the investigators who had obtained the revoked confessions and denied the accusation that they'd used unethical tactics or applied unnecessary pressure.
sentences.zh: 齐格勒法官为那些获取了被撤销供词的调查人员进行了辩护，并否认了他们使用不道德手段或施加不必要压力的指控。

sentences.en: He believed the accused were pretending to be less intelligent than they really were and could provide no explanation for why they had provided false statements.
sentences.zh: 他认为被告是在装傻，并对他们为何提供虚假陈述无法给出解释。

sentences.en: Judge Ziegler concluded that someone in the Rup household had killed Rudolf, he just couldn't be sure exactly who or how.
sentences.zh: 齐格勒法官总结称，鲁普家中的某个人杀害了鲁道夫，只是他无法确定具体是谁或如何杀害的。

sentences.en: Therefore, Ziegler said he had no choice but to acquit each of the defendants.
sentences.zh: 因此，齐格勒表示他别无选择，只能宣告所有被告无罪。

sentences.en: However, he denied their requests for compensation.
sentences.zh: 然而，他拒绝了他们的赔偿请求。

sentences.en: As far as Judge Ziegler was concerned,
sentences.zh: 在齐格勒法官看来，

sentences.en: Hermina, Matthias, Manuela and Andrea had chosen to make their false statements.
sentences.zh: 赫尔米娜、马蒂亚斯、曼努埃拉和安德烈亚是选择做出虚假陈述的。

sentences.en: Therefore, they only had themselves to blame for their convictions.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们只能为自己的定罪承担责任。

sentences.en: For the defence team, the verdict was only half a victory.
sentences.zh: 对于辩护团队来说，这一判决只算是一半的胜利。

sentences.en: Outside court, one of the lawyers told the press,
sentences.zh: 庭审结束后，其中一名律师告诉媒体：

sentences.en: In the wake of the verdict, scrap dealer Ludwig Hecht was charged with making false accusations against the police.
sentences.zh: 判决后，废品收购商路德维希·赫希特被指控诬告警方。

sentences.en: At his trial, a representative for the public prosecution labelled Hecht the scum of humanity and called for a prison sentence of 20 months.
sentences.zh: 在审判中，公诉方代表称赫希特是“人类的渣滓”，并要求判处他20个月监禁。

sentences.en: The judge acquitted Hecht, citing reasonable doubt as to whether he had fabricated the allegations.
sentences.zh: 法官宣告赫希特无罪，理由是对于他是否捏造了指控存在合理怀疑。

sentences.en: Over the years, lawyers for Hermina, Matthias, Manuela and Andrea continued to fight for financial compensation for the time their clients spent in prison.
sentences.zh: 多年来，赫尔米娜、马蒂亚斯、曼努埃拉和安德烈亚的律师们一直在为他们的当事人争取在狱中服刑期间的经济赔偿。

sentences.en: They argued that the accused didn't invent the false confessions that led to their convictions alone, but under pressure from the interviewing officers.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，导致被告定罪的虚假供词并非他们独自编造，而是在审讯人员的压力下做出的。

sentences.en: Their appeals have all been denied.
sentences.zh: 他们的上诉均被驳回。

sentences.en: Professor Gunter Konkan is an expert on false confessions.
sentences.zh: 冈特·孔坎教授是一位虚假供词专家。

sentences.en: He examined the video footage of the accused giving their statements to police for a television special on the Spiegel Panorama network and was shocked by what he saw.
sentences.zh: 他为明镜全景电视特别节目审查了被告向警方陈述的录像，并对所见内容感到震惊。

sentences.en: To Professor Gunter Konkan, it was obvious that the video recordings were intermittently turned off,
sentences.zh: 对冈特·孔坎教授来说，显而易见的是，录像记录曾断断续续地被关闭，

sentences.en: at which point new information was given to the accused during undocumented conversations.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，被告在未记录的谈话中被告知了新的信息。

sentences.en: When the camera started recording again, the accused would then suddenly reveal information that they'd previously been denying.
sentences.zh: 当摄像机再次开始录制时，被告就会突然透露他们之前一直否认的信息。

sentences.en: At no point in the footage did any of the authorities address these discrepancies.
sentences.zh: 在录像的任何部分，当局都没有处理这些差异。

sentences.en: To understand how someone could give a false confession,
sentences.zh: 为了理解一个人为何会做出虚假供词，

sentences.en: Professor Konkan urged viewers to consider the whole picture and not just the final outcome.
sentences.zh: 孔坎教授敦促观众考虑全局，而不仅仅是最终结果。

sentences.en: He explained that in this case there were a variety of factors at play, including insecurities, low IQs, and possible mental illness,
sentences.zh: 他解释说，在这个案件中，有多种因素在起作用，包括不安全感、智商低下以及可能的精神疾病，

sentences.en: factors which were exacerbated by isolation in custody and illegal questioning over several weeks.
sentences.zh: 这些因素因羁押期间的隔离和长达数周的非法审讯而加剧。

sentences.en: Watching the footage, Professor Konkan stated,
sentences.zh: 观看录像时，孔坎教授指出：

sentences.en: Speaking to the same program, the public prosecutor who had spearheaded the original conviction against the four accused
sentences.zh: 在接受同一节目采访时，那位曾主导对四名被告最初定罪的检察官

sentences.en: was asked how he felt when Rudolf Rupp's body was recovered from the Dunau River.
sentences.zh: 被问及当鲁道夫·鲁普的尸体从多瑙河中被打捞出来时，他有何感想。

sentences.en: The reporter asked,
sentences.zh: 记者问道：

sentences.en: The case gained massive media attention in Germany, not just because of the bizarre circumstances,
sentences.zh: 该案在德国引起了巨大的媒体关注，不仅是因为其离奇的情节，

sentences.en: but because it shattered the long-standing belief that the German legal system does not produce wrongful convictions.
sentences.zh: 更因为它打破了德国法律体系不会产生冤假错案的长期信念。

sentences.en: After the retrial, the judge from the original trial defended the original verdict, saying,
sentences.zh: 重审后，原审法官为最初的判决进行了辩护，称：

sentences.en: I never want to sentence anybody unjustified, but on the other hand, you also need to see that we are only human, and therefore, we can also be subject to human error.
sentences.zh: “我从不想不公正地判处任何人，但另一方面，你也需要看到我们只是凡人，因此，我们也会犯下人为错误。”

sentences.en: The truth about Rudolf Rupp's death remains a mystery.
sentences.zh: 关于鲁道夫·鲁普死亡的真相依然是一个谜。
